domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n > 1
t is a real number with 0 <= t and t < 1
a is defined as floor(n times t), hence a is an integer and satisfies a <= n times t and n times t < a + 1
t is within the intended input domain of E_n
a divided by n is within the intended input domain of E_n
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n > 1 and for all real numbers t with 0 <= t < 1, letting a be floor of n times t, it holds that E_n(t) <= E_n(a divided by n).
quantifier_order: for all n: integer with n greater than 1
for all t: real with 0 less than or equal to t and t less than 1
define a as floor of n times t

variables.name: a
variables.role: auxiliary value defined by floor of n times t

variables.domain: unspecified (at least defined on inputs t and a divided by n)
variables.name: E_n
variables.role: real-valued (or orderable) quantity indexed by n

witness_dependencies: a depends on both n and t via a = floor(n times t)
the argument a divided by n depends on n and t through a

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with 0 <= t < 1, if a = floor(n*t), then E_n(t) <= E_n(a/n).
